sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.price * o.quantity_product), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_id IN ('a', 'b', 'c') AND o.date >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-07-01 00:00:00';
